title: ほんと？うそ？九九の森
action: キャラクターの九九を聞いて「ほんと／うそ」を1回選ぶ
scene: 森の小さな劇場に、オオカミ、ウサギ、クマ、キツネ、ロボットが順番に登場。声と登場ポーズが毎回変わる。
layout: スマホ横844×390。中央に発言の式、左右下に固定した「○ ほんと」「× うそ」の大ボタン。右側に次のキャラクター。出題時は正答を示す強調を付けない。
copy: オオカミの ひとこと
learn: 発言の正誤を九九で判断する。答え合わせでは必ず正しい式を表示し、正しい九九だけを一緒に唱える。
payoff: 見抜くと蝶ネクタイがくるくる、耳がぴょん。次のキャラクターが拍に合わせて登場する。
music: 森のスウィング・ファンク
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE premium finished game-screen concept for a new Japanese multiplication rhythm minigame named "ほんと？うそ？九九の森". Reference image 1 is an ART STYLE and UI-family reference only: preserve its polished gouache texture, navy outlines, cream panels, vivid teal/coral/golden colors, charming expressive animal characters and bold readable Japanese typography. Invent a new forest theater scene, do NOT copy the quiz-host dog.
MANDATORY: smartphone LANDSCAPE, very wide aspect approximately 1844 x 853 (844 x 390 logical viewport). One complete gameplay view, no phone bezel, browser, poster, collage or scrolling. All essential content inset 5% left and right and 4% bottom. The upper 10% is a slim navy title/status bar. Two huge touch buttons occupy the bottom 25%, and each would be at least 56 logical px high.
Gameplay: a different animal appears each round and confidently reads a multiplication question AND its proposed answer. The player ONLY chooses whether the animal's claim is true or false. Show the moment BEFORE any selection. This example is DELIBERATELY A FALSE CLAIM: a cute gray wolf with fluffy ears, a tiny coral bow tie and teal vest is speaking "7 × 8 = 54". This arithmetic is intentionally incorrect and must appear EXACTLY as the wolf's quoted statement, never as an endorsed correct solution. The player must decide. No correctness marks, selected state or glowing correct button in this image.
Scene: magical outdoor forest comedy theater at dusk, warm string lights, leafy wooden arch, gentle rhythm sparkles. The wolf stands left-center holding a microphone, confidently making a neutral-friendly speaking gesture; do not give him a sneaky look, sweat, Pinocchio nose or visual lie cue. A very large clean cream speech bubble with a tail CLEARLY connecting to the wolf occupies upper center/right, containing the tiny label "オオカミの ひとこと" and HUGE exactly "7 × 8 = 54". Above or just below it show "ほんと？ うそ？". The wolf and bubble together dominate the image.
At the far right, three smaller visible waiting characters (rabbit, bear, fox) peek from a backstage doorway; a small "つぎは…" sign above them with a simple rightward progression makes it clear characters appear one after another. They are not answer choices. Keep this queue subordinate to the large equation.
Header text exactly "ほんと？うそ？九九の森", compact "03 / 08", pause icon.
Bottom controls: LEFT a large teal rounded button with a big white CIRCLE icon and exact label "ほんと"; RIGHT an equally large coral rounded button with a big white CROSS icon and exact label "うそ". BOTH have equally neutral, unselected styling. Bottom middle between them a compact three-beat indicator with dots leading to a star and small text "えらぼう！". Make it immediately obvious there are only TWO choices. There is NO confirm button, no answer-number keypad, no speech-recognition or microphone input button. The microphone is only in the wolf's hand.
Legible typography and numbers; avoid excess tiny copy, scoring clutter or an educational worksheet appearance. Characterful, energetic and funny, but calm readable backing around all essential text. No watermark or external brand logo. Make this genuinely look like a playable phone landscape screen.
feedbackPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Reference image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the question screen of the smartphone landscape rhythm learning game "ほんと？うそ？九九の森". Create its matching ANSWER-REVEAL screen immediately after the player correctly selected "うそ". Preserve EXACTLY the wide 1844 x 853 landscape framing, forest theater, wolf character design (gray fluffy fur, teal vest, coral bow tie, handheld microphone), rabbit/bear/fox queue, header title and 03 / 08, color family, gouache texture, thick outlines, the position and size of all major interface shapes. Do not crop or rearrange the two-button layout.
Changes only for answer reveal:
1. Replace the false equation in the huge cream speech bubble with the CORRECT equation "7 × 8 = 56", using very large readable digits. Only this correct equation appears anywhere on the result screen: REMOVE 54 completely.
2. Replace the wooden small label above the equation with exactly "ほんとうは…". Under the big correct equation, replace the question "ほんと？うそ？" with the reading "しちは ごじゅうろく". A short celebratory gold ribbon above/beside the speech bubble, safely below the header and without covering any essential content, says "みやぶった！".
3. The wolf has a surprised delighted face, raised eyebrows, and his bow tie comically spins sideways. A few small golden leaves pop around him. It is a friendly humorous reaction, no humiliation or anger. The waiting animals cheer.
4. Keep LEFT teal button circle icon and label "ほんと", but subdued. Keep RIGHT coral button CROSS icon and label "うそ" in the exact same position, clearly selected with a gold outline and a small "せいかい！" badge. Very important: the right button's cross is the chosen FALSE answer and the player has SUCCEEDED, it must not look like an incorrect-player-answer screen.
5. Replace the little bottom-middle "えらぼう！" with "いっしょに！" and three musical notes, inviting a correct spoken repetition. No additional next/confirm button: the following animal will enter automatically.
Mobile readability: all text in the short wide viewport; 5% side inset, no clipped controls, no scrolling, no device bezel, no multi-panel composition. Maintain the same production quality.

plan.status: 画面デザインと企画。ゲーム・音声は未実装。

rhythm.introOutro: 前奏と終奏各4拍を加え約68秒。ゆっくりモードは考える小節を追加。

timeline.event: キャラクターが登場して、問題と提示答を読み上げる。例「なな かける はちは、ごじゅうよん！」。同じ内容を吹き出しに表示。
ほんと／うそのどちらかを1回選ぶ。初級はこの時間内の入力をすべて受け付ける。
正誤と正しい式を表示。全員で「しちは ごじゅうろく」。すぐ次のキャラクターに交代する。

learning: 最初の手本では正しい九九を見せてから判断に入る。未学習の式をいきなり嘘だけで覚えさせない。
嘘の発言は1回で止め、結果では誤答を消して正しい式と読みを主役にする。プレイヤーが間違えた場合も正しい九九を穏やかに確認する。
キャラクター・声色・表情で正誤を判別できないよう、全員が本当と嘘の両方を言う。正誤の順番も固定しない。
判定の正解とリズム評価を分ける。拍を外しても数学的な正解は取り消さない。無回答は無回答として保存する。
2択の正答だけで九九を習得済みにしない。数問後は同じ式を別キャラクターで、別のゲームでは答え自体を選ぶ形でも確認する。
audio: 既存試作の音声素材を再生する仕組みを使い、キャラクターの発言と正しい九九の唱え声を別ファイルにする。
発言は通常の話し声、正しい九九は短い音楽フレーズにする。まずオオカミとウサギの2声で8問を作り、声が聞き分けやすいか確かめてから増やす。
1問の発言を音声ファイルとして事前生成し、長さを測って4秒以内に収める。収まらない場合は台詞を短くするか思考用小節を増やす。
曲、音声、入力受付を共通の音声時計で進める。話している間は伴奏を下げ、答え合わせの声が終わってから交代する。
マイクは使わず、タップだけで完結。音声を切っても吹き出しと拍表示で遊べる。
prototypeChecks: 初めて見ても2択操作が分かる
発言を最後まで聞く時間がある
キャラクターの見た目で当てていない
誤答より正しい九九が記憶に残るか試遊で確認
スマホ横で指が式を隠さない
plan.cheersRule: 120 BPMの13拍目から正しい九九を読み上げる。残りが短ければ掛け声を省略し、長い『みやぶったね』は節目にあらかじめ設けた1小節で使う。
plan.animationStrategy: 生成したキーポーズと透過パーツを組み合わせる。4〜6ポーズを補間・差分再生し、位置・回転・拡大縮小はゲーム側で連続的に動かす。
